overview_description.description: Sorce provides a job search app that uses an AI agent to apply to roles on behalf of candidates. Users browse and swipe through listings, and the agent fills application forms and submits details supplied in the profile, reducing repetitive questions. The service spans roles across industries, from entry-level positions to senior roles, including technical and business functions. The platform includes referral links for onboarding and offers support via founders@sorce.jobs. Sorce focuses on simplifying the application process while keeping users in control of which jobs to pursue.
